groups.title: Head
groups.info: The outside of the head: skin, skull and eyes.

groups.title: Skull bones
groups.info: The skull split into its main parts. Bone is dark on MRI, so these shapes are an atlas-guided estimate.

groups.title: Eyes & optic nerves
groups.info: The cables and tiny muscles behind the eyeballs.

groups.title: Brain surface
groups.info: The outer surface of the cortex as one smooth sheet. It can be inflated like a balloon to show the hidden folds.

groups.title: Cortex (by lobe)
groups.info: The wrinkled outer layer of the brain, split into regions.

groups.title: Corpus callosum
groups.info: The bridge of nerve fibres joining the two halves of the brain.

groups.title: Hypothalamus area
groups.info: Small structures at the base of the brain that run hormones, hunger, sleep and memory circuits.

groups.title: Cerebellum
groups.info: The “little brain” at the back: movement, balance and timing.

groups.title: Cerebellum lobules
groups.info: The cerebellum divided into its numbered lobules.

groups.title: Inner ear
groups.info: Hearing and balance organs, each about 1 cm across.

groups.title: Veins
groups.info: Veins draining blood from the brain.
